title: ProBuild Tier Placement Rules
content:
A member's tier in Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards is decided by qualifying spend in the program year, measured against each tier's annual qualifying spend threshold, with movement up during the year and a single evaluation on January 1.

## Rules

**R1. Basis.** A member's tier is decided by qualifying spend in the program year (the calendar year, a qualification period of the tier's stated number of months) against each tier's annual qualifying spend threshold.

**R2. Upgrade during the year.** Where the tier provides for upgrade during the year, the member moves up on the day year-to-date qualifying spend first reaches a higher tier's threshold, to the highest tier reached, and receives that tier's tier bonus points once per program year, as points earned on the tier-bonus basis.

**R3. Annual evaluation.** At the annual evaluation on January 1, the tier for the new year is the highest tier whose threshold the closed year's spend reached, but a member never drops more than the tier's maximum drop (the most tiers dropped at one annual evaluation) below the tier held on December 31, and a tier earned during a year is kept for the tier's hold period, in months, after that year ends.

**R4. Reset.** The year's qualifying spend is then reset to zero, by one year-end reset entry for the membership for that program year, dated January 1 and taking out the closed year's qualifying spend.

**R5. No movement down within a year.** A tier never moves down during a program year, and returns that lower year-to-date spend below a threshold do not undo an upgrade already made.

## Worked cases (hypothetical members)

**Case A, several thresholds on one day.** A ProBuild Bronze member's year-to-date qualifying spend is below the ProBuild Silver threshold. One credited purchase lifts it to a figure that reaches both the ProBuild Silver and the ProBuild Gold thresholds but not the ProBuild Platinum threshold. Under R2 the member moves up that day to ProBuild Gold, the highest tier reached, and receives the tier bonus points of ProBuild Gold once for that program year.

**Case B, a return after the upgrade.** Later in the same year the member of Case A returns goods, and year-to-date spend falls below the ProBuild Gold threshold. Under R5 the member stays at ProBuild Gold for the rest of the program year.

**Case C, January 1 after Case B.** The closed year's spend reached the ProBuild Silver threshold but not the ProBuild Gold threshold. ProBuild Gold was earned during that year, so under R3 it is kept for the hold period after the year ends.

**Case D, the drop limit.** A member held ProBuild Platinum on December 31 under no hold covering the new year, and the closed year's spend reached only the ProBuild Bronze threshold. Where the most tiers dropped at one evaluation is one, the new tier is ProBuild Gold, one tier below ProBuild Platinum, rather than ProBuild Bronze.

**Case E, the reset.** On January 1, after the evaluation, one year-end reset entry takes the closed year's qualifying spend out, and the new program year's qualifying spend starts at zero.
